facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during start-up after maintenance on ZV-7210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on ZV-7210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. ZV-7210 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 6 August 2015 a regulatory notice was issued concerning ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal following start-up after maintenance.
